items: Differentiate RPA 1950 (voter qualification, delimitation, seat allocation) from RPA 1951 (actual conduct of elections, corrupt practices, qualifications for membership).
Proportional Representation by Means of Single Transferable Vote (STV) is used for Rajya Sabha and Presidential elections, NOT for Lok Sabha elections.
Model Code of Conduct is non-statutory; it does not have backing by enforceable law, but ECI enforces it via guidelines and moral suasion.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Model Code of Conduct (MCC) comes into force immediately upon the announcement of the election schedule by the Election Commission.
NOTA (None of the Above) was introduced following a Supreme Court ruling in 2013 to preserve voter secrecy and right to reject.
The First-Past-The-Post (FPTP) system requires a candidate to secure more votes than any other candidate, not necessarily a majority.
The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 lowered the voting age from 21 to 18 years by amending Article 326.
VVPAT (Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail) units generate a physical paper slip visible for 7 seconds to verify EVM votes.
